experiment_template.research_question: With one common budgeted output-cap correction, does tokenizer-fitted state improve native evidence selection after recycling?
stop_conditions: Failed or corrective model tokens are omitted.
More than one incomplete-output correction occurs in a cell.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells.

records.falsifier: Correction is unbounded, failed usage is omitted, arm behavior differs, state exceeds its cap, treatment completion degrades, or the fixed paired native target is not met.
records.mechanism: Retain the failed response receipt and tokens, expose none of its incomplete body, append a fixed concise-action correction for one additional admitted request, and otherwise preserve H14 exact-generation token fitting. Apply the correction identically to control and treatment.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state with one budgeted output-cap correction common to both arms.
records.statement: With one common budgeted concise-action correction for a length-limited response, tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state can complete and improve useful native evidence selection.

records.research_question: With one common budgeted output-cap correction, does tokenizer-fitted state improve native evidence selection after recycling?
stop_conditions: Any second incomplete output, correction count above one, omitted failed usage, state-cap failure, speculative measurement, or unmatched presentation is an instrument failure.
No acceptance or successor selection changes from observed outcomes.
No within-round change, replacement, source refresh, threshold change or lucky rerun.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempt.

success_criteria.scope: Eight exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K fitted-state pairs with common output recovery; no full cohort, larger window, confirmation, correctness, transfer or clearance claim.

records.claim: All 16 cells completed, but the seven complete pairs had mean state-minus-control span F1 of -0.0655 versus the fixed +0.05 target. State used 86,838 more model tokens and recycled twelve more times; 52 of 89 presentations repeated within a generation and directly occupied 42,681 model-input tokens.
limitations: Native evidence selection does not establish repair correctness or semantic retention.
No output-cap correction received live exposure.

records.next_action: Retain exact state fitting and typed output recovery as bounded instrumentation. Change only state cadence: inject one receipt-bound state on the first dispatched request of each recycled generation, then omit it until the next boundary. Freeze a new method-bound round against no-state control.
